title: Guided Rainforest & Suspension Bridge Private Hike
includes: All trips include the use of hiking poles and rain ponchos if desired
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your adventure begins on a suspension bridge overlooking a jaw-dropping canyon and waterfall in Lynn Canyon park, similar scenery to Capilano, without the crowds. We'll explore a vast trail network winding through temperate rainforest, where I'll share the secrets of this incredible ecosystem. We'll seek out old-growth trees, spot native birds, discover hidden waterfalls, and take in the lush world of ferns, moss, and towering conifers.
There's a variety of trails and distances, but there is some elevation gain after the bridge. On warm days, the brave can take a dip in the crystal-clear, glacially fed pools, nature's own cold plunge. We'll finish with a hot tea or coffee at the café nestled right in the park before your ride home.
The tour typically runs 3–4 hours, including the drive, with the option to go longer for those wanting deeper exploration. Private pickup and drop-off anywhere in Vancouver.
